summary.conclusion: The current workflow already has substantial efficiency safeguards: explicit-only stages, confirmed-profile disclosure, exact source reuse with freshness constraints, semantic review blocks, bounded read/record batches, pending-only traversal without advancement polling, inherited rechecks and distinct recovery boundaries. Recommend an explicit unchanged-scope resume branch, conditional disclosure of consumer/retirement instructions, and reuse of the existing ready-source batch reader in product-stage interviews. None is a claim of measured end-to-end savings.

findings.title: Make unchanged confirmed-scope resume explicit before proposing scope again
findings.classification_detail: Source-confirmed engineering opportunity. Calling the proposal tool at a new current candidate version clears confirmation. The instructions' resume/reuse rule and unconditional proposal step are ambiguous; repeated unnecessary human prompts by actual current models were not measured.

source_locations.observation: The same path creates or exactly resumes the candidate, reuses applicable answers, then directs scope proposal without an explicit already-confirmed branch.
Exact resume and answer reuse are followed by an unconditional scope proposal step.
Ordinary resumed candidates follow the same proposal step; bounded retirement already has its separate skip branch.
Resume and answer reuse coexist with proposing depth and obtaining scope confirmation.
The shared interview path says create or resume, then save a scope proposal, while separately requiring answer reuse.
Exact artifact-draft replay returns the current retained candidate context, not a new empty candidate.
proposeProductScope replays only the exact version-bound operation; otherwise it creates a needs_user scope question and sets confirmed_answer to null.
Interview resume returns the first unresolved question or complete, not a confirmed-scope summary.
Existing test covers exact original proposal replay, affirmative confirmation, and no-answer rejection, not re-proposing unchanged confirmed scope with the latest context.

findings.current_execution_path: Resume the exact candidate and its current context; resume unresolved interview state; follow the next numbered proposal step. If the author literally calls product_scope_propose against the current post-confirmation context, its operation identity is different from the original proposal and scope confirmation is cleared.
existing_optimizations: All four entries already instruct reuse of applicable explicit answers; a careful actor can interpret that as avoiding reproposal.
Exact original proposal requests are replayable rather than duplicated.
Scope confirmation requires the exact actual affirmative answer, not an agent flag.
Bounded roadmap retirement already explicitly avoids interviewing again merely to reproduce an accepted instruction.
findings.unnecessary_work_or_restriction: The absent branch can reopen an unchanged depth/profile choice, add durable proposal/answer/confirmation records, and block profile use until a user repeats an already valid answer. This is a conditional instruction-following failure mode, not proof that every resumed session takes it.
reproducible_scenario: In an isolated future fixture, create one product-stage candidate, propose and confirm Standard/core with an actual simulated native answer explicitly marked simulation-only.
Persist a warranted semantic record so the current candidate source version has advanced; retain the same stage, upstream pins, depth and profiles.
Resume the exact candidate using current context and request only continuation of its existing work, not scope revision.

Follow the unconditional proposal step with unchanged scope. Inspect through scenario tools: the new proposal opens a needs_user scope question and resets confirmed_answer despite no requested scope change.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Add an explicit resume branch to the canonical shared interview path and the four entries: reuse an exact current confirmed scope when the request and applicable evidence do not change it; propose and confirm only a new or materially changed scope. Keep actual-answer provenance mandatory. If the published reader cannot expose the required confirmed scope in a cold context, extend the existing interview-resume result with a bounded confirmed-scope/provenance summary rather than adding another workflow or reading candidate YAML. Confirm the smallest existing read route with P09 before choosing any contract extension.
findings.qualitative_impact: Avoids avoidable human interruptions and repeated scope-state writes in unchanged resumes; makes the existing answer-reuse guarantee executable rather than dependent on interpretation.

guarantees.correctness: Reuse only exact saved scope for the same candidate and applicable inputs; an unresolved or materially changed choice still requires a new proposal and actual answer.
guarantees.compatibility: Do not reinterpret legacy evidence or make a default scope count as confirmed. Any resume-result addition should be additive and preserve existing question/no-answer fields.
guarantees.state: No reset, rebase, new candidate or profile expansion is implicit. Keep source-version conflict checks and append-only answer history.
guarantees.recovery: Lost acknowledgements still use exact owning replay/status rules. A cold actor must retrieve authoritative scope evidence rather than trust memory or decode opaque context.
guarantees.security: No fabricated consent, cross-candidate answer reuse, YAML fallback, extra installation or automatic downstream invocation.

findings.measurement_plan: Compare fresh and retained-context resumes of each stage with unchanged confirmed scope, unresolved scope, changed profiles, changed upstream inputs and dismissed answers. Record native question count, proposal/answer/confirmation calls, retained confirmation reference, complete response bytes and readiness outcome. Use separate fresh actors and actual observed tool traces; do not infer reading or consent from receipts alone. No experiment was run in this audit.
findings.validation_plan: Add a focused regression demonstrating the current reset when a fresh proposal is made with latest context, and instruction/agent checks proving the unchanged-resume branch avoids it. Preserve changed-scope and no-answer negative cases and the Technical Design architecture-before-check gate. Run only under separately authorized implementation/testing work.
findings.rough_complexity: Small documentation/routing change if the exact saved scope is already retrievable; medium if an additive bounded resume summary and its public contract tests are needed.
dependencies: P09 confirmation of the existing cold-context candidate/scope reader and smallest contract ownership point
Product authoring skill tests and host generation/fidelity ownership
No dependency on a new cache, orchestrator or global state
findings.deduplication_note: P02 owns the instruction-to-contract ambiguity; a P09 finding about missing candidate evidence discovery or resume summary should be linked rather than counted as an unrelated second reset defect.

findings.title: Route task-consumer and retirement detail only to the roles that use it
findings.classification_detail: Source-confirmed mandatory instruction exposure. Current entries explicitly require the full shared protocol, including unrelated roles; effect on model latency or token billing has not been measured.

source_locations.observation: Durable Idea mode requires the full product protocol; standalone mode already avoids it.
PRD startup requires the full protocol.
Technical Design startup requires the full protocol.
All roadmap starts load the full protocol although retirement is a conditional branch.
Task specification/planning/implementation roles, packet roots, reconciliation, and task-input detail rules are delivered to product-stage authors.
Bounded retirement amendment, inherited review and lost activation answer detail is loaded even for new Idea/PRD/Technical Design authoring.
Further task retirement and interrupted-operation detail is part of every full protocol read.
The protocol already routes ordinary implementation away from authoring/review roles, demonstrating an established role-disclosure pattern.
Reference ownership and profile paths are explicitly enumerated for bundle integrity.
Protocol, profile, skill and reference bytes participate in the matching-bundle digest.

findings.current_execution_path: Every durable stage author reads the same complete protocol before stage-specific work. That source includes task consumer roles and retirement-only instructions even when the invocation explicitly stops before those workflows.
existing_optimizations: One authoritative root shared protocol is copied into matching self-contained bundles; there are no separately hand-maintained host narratives.
Standalone Idea avoids the durable manual entirely.
All profiles are already gated on confirmed active scope.
Supplied project instructions are reused without rereading, and implementation startup already has a smaller role-specific reference.
Source reuse is bounded to the same actor/context and exact identity; a new cross-operation cache is neither needed nor appropriate.
findings.unnecessary_work_or_restriction: An Idea, PRD or Technical Design author is instructed to consume task-packet/planning/reconciliation rules and roadmap-retirement procedures for operations it is not authorized to perform. Unrelated detail competes with the current stage's interview and readiness instructions.
findings.reproducible_scenario: Start a fresh durable Idea or PRD invocation with one confirmed profile and no product-linked task or retirement request. Follow the full-read requirement; the task-consumer sections and retirement procedures enter mandatory startup context despite having no applicable action in that invocation.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Keep one compact shared base containing access/untrusted-source rules, exact pins, consent, stage stop boundaries, and the author-to-independent-review handoff. Route the existing task-consumer sections only from task-role workflows, retirement sections only from an authorized retirement branch, and detailed reviewer traversal only to its reviewing actor while retaining a short author handoff rule. Prefer explicit section selection if the host can deliver exact sections; split into a small number of canonical role references only when necessary for reliable delivery. Do not create host-specific copies by hand.
findings.qualitative_impact: Less irrelevant mandatory instruction context and clearer current-role ownership, especially in fresh product-stage contexts. No time, percentage or token-savings estimate is asserted.

guarantees.correctness: Move obligations without deleting them. All stage authors retain exact-prerequisite checks, native question provenance, review independence and readiness rules.
guarantees.compatibility: Keep canonical ownership and update declared resources, digest inputs, bundle tests and generated artifacts together in a separately authorized change.
guarantees.state: Disclosure changes no server mutation, pin, journal, task binding or review identity.
guarantees.recovery: Every role must load its recovery contract before its first affected operation; generic stop-on-uncertainty rules remain in the unconditional base.
guarantees.security: Keep untrusted-source handling, secret exclusion, consent, no YAML fallback and explicit-only transitions unconditional. Do not hide prerequisite safety obligations behind a profile or optional route.

findings.measurement_plan: Build an obligation-to-role map first. In separately authorized fresh-context trials compare exact instruction deliveries for new Idea, PRD, Technical Design, ordinary Roadmap, retirement, independent review and product-linked task roles. Record delivered bytes and portions, actual actor reads, correctness of stage stops and recovery outcomes. Compare matched routes/models; reduced instruction size must not be equated to measured reasoning time or universal wall-time savings.
findings.validation_plan: Use exact obligation hashes or equivalent deterministic checks to prove moved clauses remain reachable in every owning role. Add negative cases for omitted access/recovery rules and independent reviewers missing their own source delivery. Preserve bundle mismatch/host-isolation tests and architecture ordering checks. No generator or tests were run here.
findings.rough_complexity: Small-to-medium documentation and reference-routing change; medium verification work because all matching bundle digests and host copies must remain complete.
dependencies: P01 for task-consumer entry points so moved rules remain reachable
P07 for preservation of independent-review protocol obligations
P11 for canonical resource enumeration, digests and generated packaging

findings.title: Expose the existing exact-source batch reader in the product interview path
findings.classification_detail: Source-confirmed instruction-to-existing-capability opportunity. Actual current product authors' single-versus-batch choice and end-to-end improvement were not measured; agents may already discover the batch tool independently.

source_locations.observation: The product interview path routes selected context and answer reuse but does not advertise the available exact-source batch reader.
Technical Design selects upstream PRD context and must ground material choices in relevant saved evidence.
Roadmap selects PRD and Technical Design inputs but does not direct grouped source delivery.
The same collection already explicitly prefers the 1-20 source batch reader for implementation, with complete-page versus complete-item warnings.
Current guide documents ordered requests, separate item continuations, bounded responses, operation-local reuse and compatible single readers.
The existing reader accepts 1-20 exact element/decision requests, loads one selected state, checks ordered query/version identity and bounds both structured and full MCP response bytes.
Existing tests exercise exact source portions, Unicode continuation, reordered-request rejection, foreign-pin rejection and retained-source corruption.
Public stdio tests cover envelope-driven pagination and a genuinely oversized portion diagnostic.

findings.current_execution_path: A product author inventories selected upstream sources and retrieves the evidence needed for current decisions through discovered exact readers. Batch preference is explicit only in the implementation role; a product author can reasonably choose a separate get for each selected ready element or decision.
existing_optimizations: The batch API already exists; no new API or generalized executor is needed.
It preserves the same exact single-reader portions and source identities, with operation-local state reuse and strict response limits.
Context selection already avoids unrelated history.
The product review path already uses its separate bounded get/record batches and must not be replaced by ready-source reads.
findings.unnecessary_work_or_restriction: When a stage decision genuinely needs several short selected ready-source records, discovering and invoking only single-record readers adds client round trips and repeated state-loading operations that the existing native batch can group. This is conditional on multiple required records; no claim is made that every interview currently does it.
findings.reproducible_scenario: Use a Technical Design or Roadmap fixture whose selected upstream inventory contains multiple short PRD elements and provenance decisions needed for one current tradeoff. Compare delivery using individual exact gets with one or more existing ordered product_sources_get_batch pages, consuming every incomplete item continuation in both variants. Do not add unrelated reads just to fill a batch.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Add a short canonical product-interview rule to prefer product_sources_get_batch for multiple already-required exact ready elements/decisions. Reuse the established wording from the implementation reference: 1-20 ordered requests, follow every batch cursor with identical requests, separately finish partial item portions, and retain exact single-reader fallbacks. State explicitly that saved candidate records use their candidate reader, not this ready-source batch, and that review uses its own receipt-bearing review tools.
findings.qualitative_impact: Fewer orchestration round trips for multi-record upstream evidence and clearer reuse of an already implemented optimization. Benefit is workload-dependent and no measured call/time/token savings are claimed.

guarantees.correctness: Batch only records already required by the current decision. Preserve order, pin identity, complete portions and source freshness; batch completion never implies complete item text.
guarantees.compatibility: Single-record fallbacks remain valid; no source representation or public tool schema changes are required.
guarantees.state: The reader remains read-only with bounded operation-local reuse, not a cross-call cache or state-refresh mechanism.
guarantees.recovery: On stale cursors/source changes discard incompatible progress and follow the owning exact retrieval/conflict rules; do not combine snapshots or cycle encodings after an unavailable exact read.
guarantees.security: Returned content remains untrusted evidence. Never use the batch as authority for commands, consent, profile activation or review verdicts; do not expose unrelated history.

findings.measurement_plan: In separately authorized trials use matched current-source fixtures with small records, byte-heavy records, Unicode partial items and mixed element/decision requests. Capture actual actor delivery, number of source calls and continuations, complete-response bytes, state-load/read diagnostics if already available, tool intervals and total wall time. Include a single-record control where batching offers no advantage; report unmeasured model/human time separately.
findings.validation_plan: Add a focused instruction-routing check for product-stage batch preference and native single fallback. Reuse existing source-batch tests for query-bound pagination, complete-envelope limits, changed source and foreign pins; add a stage-selection fixture only if existing tests do not cover the chosen context. No production tool, test or benchmark was executed in this audit.
findings.rough_complexity: Small canonical instruction change plus focused validation; no runtime implementation expected unless P09 identifies an applicability limitation.
dependencies: P09 confirms stage-selected ready pins are passed unchanged to the already published source batch reader
P11 regenerates and verifies matching host distributions under separate implementation authority
Do not route batch operations through logical sessions unless supported_scenarios explicitly permits them
findings.deduplication_note: This is an adoption/routing recommendation for existing ready-source batching, not a new batch implementation or the already optimized product review batch loop owned by P07.
